Name: Bind Emotes
Author: deykfa
Description:
Mod that allow you to bind emotes as you like. After installing it you need to bind emotes in [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]GMCM[/url] in menu or just in game. It works in multiplayer. That's it.

[size=4][b]Installation[/b][/size]
Install Bind Emotes archive.
Unzip the mod folder into [color=#93c47d][font=Verdana]Stardew Valley/Mods[/font][/color]
Run the game using SMAPI.

[size=4]If you like this mod please endorse it. If you find any bugs, please report them.[/size]
